propositions: Plans and contributors edit derived files by line number instead of sources, causing drift gate failures and CI round-trip waste when edits go to the wrong artifact
Two JSON-formatted derived surfaces (index.json and criterion-pins.json) have no comment syntax and carry no marker to identify themselves as generated, creating discovery friction
Fixed-point markers in JSON files must be emitted by generators themselves so regeneration reproduces them byte-for-byte, otherwise the drift gate strips them and fails
Two existing on-disk equality tests assert that committed files match builder outputs and must be re-pointed from pure builders to marker-bearing serialized shapes
A single authoritative table in docs/README.md documenting all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces, with explicit flags for hand-authored-but-gated surfaces, prevents staleness and guides contributors
